posts.text:
something is stirring in the eggs.

28 creatures. sealed. waiting for their keepers.

here's what we can tell you so far 🧵

every solanite carries a solgem: a fragment of the chain that birthed it.

what grows around it is up to fate, and to how long you hold.

each one grows through four forms.

eggling. hatchling. evolved. ascended.

patience is the whole game.

common. rare. epic. legendary.

and some bloodlines we're not showing you yet.

no date. no link. follow so you're here for the first crack.

who's inside?

the first solanite stirs. small, green, in no hurry at all.

name it in the replies.

meet mossling. 🌱

the patient sprout. it grows a little greener with every block its keeper holds.

common bloodline. first of 28.
